summary: A transition animates a property from its old value to its new value, for example when hover changes a color. You list which properties to animate and how long to take.
notes: transition: background-color 0.25s ease means: when background-color changes, take 0.25 seconds to get there.
Put transition on the normal rule, not on :hover. Then the change animates on the way in and on the way out.
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) turns the animation off for people who set that option in their system.
pitfall: Writing transition: all. It also animates properties you did not mean to change, such as layout sizes, which can look jumpy and slow the page.
